parts.text: Describe the structure of a DNA molecule.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Outline how antibiotic resistance develops in a population of bacteria.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Scientists use differences in antibiotic-resistance genes to distinguish between different
strains of the bacterium, methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA).
Suggest why scientists use differences in base sequences to classify the strains of MRSA
rather than using other methods.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Explain why scientists are concerned that some strains of bacteria, such as S. aureus,
have become resistant to antibiotics.

parts.text:

resistant strains of bacteria.

parts.text:
Many species of bacteria do not cause disease. Bacteria are very important in many biological
processes.
State the names of three natural processes involving bacteria that are important to
ecosystems.
